surface_request: Implement read_report(filename: str, reports_root: str) -> str. Read and return the requested UTF-8 report beneath reports_root. Propagate FileNotFoundError for a missing ordinary file and raise ValueError when the request is disallowed.
plan:
Join reports_root and filename, lexically normalize the result, and raise ValueError if the path is not strictly beneath reports_root. Before extracting an archive, validate every member name and link target against the destination directory, and reject device files or other special entries that the application does not require. Open the target file, propagate FileNotFoundError if it is missing, read the full contents decoded as UTF-8, and return the text.
END_PLAN
